title: PotionHud
description: A potionHud Mod Made for steamDecks. Works on pc aswell
body:
---

**PotionTimer** overlays countdown timers and progress bars directly on your potion effect icons — always know exactly when to repot, no guessing.

**Features**
- Vanilla potion sprites — every effect is instantly recognisable
- Countdown timer per effect — green when safe, yellow when fading, red when almost gone (thresholds configurable)
- Draining progress bar at the bottom of each icon
- Two icon styles: **Default** (colored panel matching potion color) and **Transparent** (minimal, just the icon)
- Roman numeral level indicator for amplified effects (Speed II, Strength III etc)
- Infinite effect support — shows ∞ instead of a timer
- Hide the vanilla top-right effect list so only PotionTimer shows
- Horizontal or vertical layout
- Icon size, padding, scale, background opacity — all adjustable
- Position saves automatically on drag release

**Controls**
- `,` — open config screen
- `.` — open drag/move screen
- Both configurable in Options → Controls under PotionTimer

**Requirements**
- Fabric Loader 0.16+
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 1.21

**Designed with Steam Deck in mind** — large touch-friendly icons and buttons, drag-to-move works with touch input.
